# GitHub Copilot Instructions for ZevBlock

Before answering questions or generating code:
1. Consult `AGENT_RULES.md` and the `brain/` directory (`brain/README.md`, `brain/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `brain/TECH_STACK.md`, `brain/SYSTEM_STATE.md`, `brain/RULES.md`, `brain/CHANGELOG.md`).
2. Always respect the Change Lock protocol: whenever you modify the codebase, document your changes in `brain/CHANGELOG.md` and keep the relevant `brain/` documentation up to date.
3. Keep ZevBlock 100% on-device and privacy-first.
